heading: Woohoo! The delivery rate has reached 96% !

blocks.html: This delivery system has already launched in Dec 2023. Since the implementation of this application, the delivery rate has increased from 80% to 96%, has more than DOUBLED 🎉 Espoirer's order volume, marking a substantial and positive impact on the company's overall business performance.
Single package enrollment time has been reduced from over 30S to 1S.
The order volume of Espoirer has increased by more than doubled.
